answer: Our protocol enforces quadratic slashing on locked collateral, converting coordinated double-signing into a terminal economic penalty that exposes the cheap-identity fable. By binding each consensus vertex to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay proof, the marginal attack cost scales super-linearly with cluster size to make hostile coalitions unprofitable. Consequently, this dynamic guarantees negative expected utility for adversaries, establishing the network as a robust Nash equilibrium and secure transactional haven.
